title: Story 1 — ES Client & Config Foundation
description:
Implement the foundation modules described in `docs/tribesrn/persistence/slices/01-foundation-spec.md` §6, §7, §8. Build on the project skeleton from Story 0 (hwf-ybj) and the locked spec values from Story A (hwf-9r9).

**Always-in-context spec files (read all three before starting):**
- `docs/tribesrn/persistence/slices/00-shared-context.md`
- `docs/tribesrn/persistence/slices/01-foundation-spec.md`
- `docs/tribesrn/persistence/slices/01-foundation-tests.md`

**Files to author** (paths relative to `tribes-api/`):
- `app/repositories/es/client.py` — `get_es_client()` per spec §6 (singleton via `lru_cache`, `AsyncElasticsearch`, `retry_on_timeout=True`, `max_retries=3`, `request_timeout=10`, `sniff_on_start=False`).
- `app/repositories/es/config.py` — `ESConfig` Pydantic-settings class per spec §6 (env_prefix `TRIBES_`, `es_url`, `es_api_key`, `es_index_prefix='tribes'`, properties for each index name including `pending_jobs_index`).
- `app/repositories/es/exceptions.py` — full domain exception hierarchy per spec §7. Include the cross-cutting exceptions enumerated at the end of §7 (e.g., `MergeIntegrityError`, `BinWriteVerificationError`, `StaleCursorError`, `MappingMigrationConflictError`, `VersionConflictError`, `EsTimeoutError`, `EsServerError`, `EsMappingConflictError`, `EsScriptError`, `InvalidPhoneError`, `InvalidBinNameError`, `InvalidTribeShapeError`) — they all subclass `TribesRepositoryError`.
- `app/repositories/es/indices/manager.py` — `ensure_indices(client, config)` per spec §8. Idempotent (skips existing indices). Wires `PENDING_JOBS_MAPPING` from §4 (using the locked-in field names from Story A).
- `app/repositories/es/indices/pending_jobs.py` — exports `PENDING_JOBS_MAPPING` constant matching the (locked) spec §4 mapping. Other index mappings (contacts/bins/assignments/tribes) are owned by their domain slices — leave their `*.py` files as empty stubs.

**Tests to author / wire** (in `tests/`):
- All Foundation tests from `01-foundation-tests.md` whose subject is in scope: index manager bootstrap (T-MAP-011, T-MAP-101), pending-jobs mapping shape (T-MAP-081, T-MAP-087), V1 vector-absence regression guard, mapping migration conflict (T-MAP-102, T-MAP-103). Tests for index mappings owned by other slices are out of scope here.
- Use `@pytest.mark.integration` for ES-touching tests; ephemeral Docker ES is the test target. The polecat must have Docker running locally to verify green.

**Done when:**
- All listed modules implemented per spec.
- All in-scope foundation tests pass against an ephemeral Docker ES (real, not mocked).
- `pytest -m integration tests/` is green locally on the polecat's worktree.
- No `from elasticsearch` imports in any file under `app/services/` (none exist yet, but the rule starts here).
- Branch pushed and handed to refinery.

Refinery will verify: code matches spec contract, tests pass on a fresh Docker ES, no leak of `elasticsearch` types in public surfaces.
acceptance_criteria: All Story-1 modules implemented per spec §6/§7/§8. Foundation integration tests green against ephemeral Docker ES. No ES types leaked from public interfaces.

title: Story A — Lock 5 spec/test discrepancies for Foundation slice
description:
Resolve the five spec-vs-test discrepancies that the Foundation spec calls out in `docs/tribesrn/persistence/slices/01-foundation-spec.md` §3, §4, §5. **Adopt the spec's stated recommendations.** This is a docs-only story (no Python code). Edit all three affected files in lock-step so downstream slices (02–08) stay coherent.

**Files in scope:**
- `docs/tribesrn/persistence/slices/00-shared-context.md`
- `docs/tribesrn/persistence/slices/01-foundation-spec.md`
- `docs/tribesrn/persistence/slices/01-foundation-tests.md`

**Discrepancies to lock (decisions are pre-approved — adopt spec recommendation in every case):**

1. **`tribes_bins` shard count.** Adopt **3 primary shards**. Update wherever shared-context implies otherwise; remove the spec's "Discrepancy to resolve" callout once aligned. Test plan T-MAP-027 stays as-is.
2. **Custom analyzer name.** Adopt **`tribes_name`**. Rename every `tribes_text` reference in `01-foundation-tests.md` (T-MAP-006, T-MAP-010, and any other) to `tribes_name`. Remove the spec's recommendation note once done.
3. **`tribes_pending_jobs` `_id` scheme.** Lock to: **the document `_id` IS the `job_id`** (single value, no separate field). Update spec §4 and tests T-MAP-081 to agree. Drop the `job_id` field from the mapping if it duplicates `_id`; otherwise keep it but state explicitly that they're the same value.
4. **`payload` vs `query_dsl` field name.** Adopt **`query_dsl`** (matches spec §4 mapping). Rename every `payload` reference in the test plan to `query_dsl`.
5. **Add `next_attempt_at` field** to the `tribes_pending_jobs` mapping in spec §4 as `{ \"type\": \"date\" }`. T-MAP-087 references it; spec must define it.

**Done when:**
- All five items reconciled across the three files.
- Spec §3 and §4 "Discrepancy to resolve" / "differ" callouts are removed (or marked resolved with a one-line note).
- `git diff` cleanly shows all three files updated; no other files touched.
- Branch pushed and handed to refinery.

This story has **no code**. It does NOT block on Story 0.
acceptance_criteria: All 5 discrepancies resolved with spec recommendations across the three docs. No conflicting language remains. Diff is docs-only.
notes: Resolved 5 spec/test discrepancies in Foundation slice docs. Adopted spec recommendations: tribes_bins=3 shards, analyzer=tribes_name, _id IS job_id (field dropped), field=query_dsl, added next_attempt_at. Premise correction: T-MAP-027 was actually asserting 1 (not 3 as the spec callout claimed); aligned to 3 to satisfy the adopted decision. 6th unrelated discrepancy noted but out of scope: spec uses last_attempted while T-MAP-087 uses last_attempt_at; member_contact_ids vs member_user_ids note remains in T-MAP-066 area (line 90 of tests). Diff: 2 files, +17/-19 lines, docs-only.
close_reason: PR #1 published; bead closed per mr handoff

title: Story 0 — Bootstrap tribes-api Python project
description:
Bootstrap the Python project for the persistence layer described in `docs/tribesrn/persistence/slices/01-foundation-spec.md` §2 (Module Layout).

**Where:** Create at `/Users/dgaedcke/dev/howwefeel/tribes-api/` (subfolder of this rig).

**What to produce:**
- `pyproject.toml` with deps: `elasticsearch[async]>=8.0`, `pydantic>=2`, `pydantic-settings`, `fastapi`, plus dev deps `pytest`, `pytest-asyncio`, `pytest-mock`. Pick a sensible toolchain (uv recommended; poetry / pip-tools acceptable).
- Package skeleton matching spec §2 — `app/repositories/`, `app/repositories/es/`, `app/repositories/es/{client,config,exceptions}.py` (empty stubs), `app/repositories/es/{indices,models,repositories,identity}/__init__.py` (empty), `app/repositories/interfaces.py` (empty stub).
- `.gitignore` (Python + venv + `.env`).
- `README.md` — one paragraph describing the persistence layer, link to `../docs/tribesrn/persistence/`, dev-setup instructions.
- `tests/` directory with empty `conftest.py` and pytest config wired into `pyproject.toml`.

**Out of scope** (later stories): actual ES client logic, mappings, exception classes — Story 1 fills these in.

**Done when:**
- `tribes-api/` exists with the layout above.
- A fresh dev install runs cleanly (`uv venv && uv pip install -e \".[dev]\"` or equivalent).
- `pytest` runs and reports zero tests collected (skeleton only).
- Branch pushed and handed to refinery.
acceptance_criteria: Project bootstraps cleanly. Empty pytest run succeeds. No business logic in any module.
notes: Bootstrapped tribes-api/ at repo root: pyproject.toml (uv + hatchling, runtime deps elasticsearch[async]/pydantic/pydantic-settings/fastapi, dev deps pytest/pytest-asyncio/pytest-mock, pytest config with integration marker), .gitignore (Python+venv+.env), README, app/repositories layout per spec §2 (empty stubs), tests/conftest.py. Verified: uv venv + uv pip install -e ".[dev]" succeed; pytest collects 0 items.

title: mol-refinery-patrol
description:
Refinery patrol loop. Poured as a root-only wisp on startup:

  gc bd mol wisp mol-refinery-patrol --root-only
  gc bd update $WISP --assignee=$GC_AGENT

Each wisp is ONE iteration: check for work, merge one branch, pour
the next iteration. On crash, re-read the formula steps and determine
where you left off from context (git state, bead state, last action).

Formula steps are NOT materialized as child beads. Read the step
descriptions below and work through them in order.

The loop mechanism: every exit path (happy or early) pours the next
wisp before burning this one. The prompt only bootstraps the first wisp.

Work beads flow directly: pool → polecat → refinery → closed.
No separate MR beads. The polecat sets metadata (branch, target) on
the work bead and assigns it to the refinery. On rejection, the
refinery puts the bead back in the pool with rejection metadata.

Merge strategy is per-work-bead metadata:
- `direct` (default): fast-forward merge to target and push
- `mr` / `pr`: publish a GitHub pull request instead of landing directly

In `mr` mode, refinery treats PR publication as the terminal handoff for
the direct-bead workflow: it records the PR URL on the work bead and
closes the bead once the PR is verified.

Read each step's description before acting — Config values override defaults.
